# freshdesk_solution_article (Data Source)

Look up a single knowledge-base article by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_solution_article" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the solution article to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_id` (Number) ID of the agent credited as the author.
- `category_id` (Number) ID of the article's category.
- `created_at` (String) When the article was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Body of the article, in HTML.
- `description_text` (String) Plain-text rendering of the body.
- `folder_id` (Number) ID of the article's folder.
- `hits` (Number) How many times the article has been viewed.
- `seo_data` (String) Search-engine metadata, as JSON.
- `status` (Number) Publication state: 1 draft, 2 published.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the article.
- `thumbs_down` (Number) How many readers found the article unhelpful.
- `thumbs_up` (Number) How many readers found the article helpful.
- `title` (String) Title of the article.
- `type` (Number) Article type: 1 permanent, 2 workaround.
- `updated_at` (String) When the article was last changed (RFC 3339).
